children: On September 23, 2026, the company received a Nasdaq notice that its Market Value of Listed Securities had been below the $50,000,000 minimum for 30 consecutive business days, violating Listing Rule 5450(b)(2)(A). SANUWAVE has 180 days, until March 22, 2027, to regain compliance, and its stock will continue trading on the Nasdaq Global Market during this period; it may consider transferring to the Nasdaq Capital Market if needed.
